dashboard.onlyRecordingsStillOnThisDeviceAre: Only recordings still on this device are counted. Deleted footage is not lifetime driving history. GPS distance skips gaps over 10 seconds and implausible jumps. Recorded time is the observed log span, not engine-on time. Missing values stay unavailable; partial bars add only measured segments.
dashboard.eachDriveIsAssignedToItsLocal: Each drive is assigned to its local start date, including drives spanning midnight. Only dates with retained recordings are plotted.
dashboard.datesThatCannotBeReadAreExcluded: Dates that cannot be read are excluded from dated graphs.
